verdict.rationale: Running untrusted code in sandboxes is a fair question for an edge-compute and hosting platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents only serverless functions, edge-adjacent integrations and deploy previews. Nothing describes hardware-isolated (e.g. microVM), disposable sandboxes for executing untrusted code, so serverless functions are at most an adjacent feature and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run untrusted code in hardware-isolated, disposable sandboxes
